title: Aethelweave

classification.guidance: Preserve the concept as Lexi.PHYS worldbuilding and convert it into software artifacts: material cards, stress-field visualizations, repair-state simulations, and pitch visuals. Do not present it as literal vacuum engineering or completed quantum hardware.

concept: The Aethelweave represents the pinnacle of post-material engineering, utilizing Quantum Entanglement Draping (QED) to bypass the limitations of traditional molecular bonding. By synchronizing the quantum states of subatomic particles across a multi-dimensional spatial grid, the Loom "drapes" structural integrity directly into the vacuum, manifesting hyper-tenacious metamaterials that are simultaneously weightless and indestructible. This revolutionary "Structural Tailoring" process allows for the real-time synthesis of self-repairing aerospace hulls and adaptive nanostructures that respond instantly to external stress vectors.

blocked_claims: literal structure draped into the vacuum
prototype_conversion.first_safe_demo: Create a 2D stress-grid simulation where cells change stiffness, damage state, and repair progress in response to external force vectors.
